summary: Lazy camera configuration loader. Allocates and initializes an 84-byte camera config object at this+0x18 on first call, truncates the path buffer, appends "cams.cfg" and invokes a vtable+4 method on the config object to load it. On success copies the settings directory path (dword_5EC440, or byte_5EA438 fallback) over the buffer, appends "default.cfg" and loads that too; when the second load succeeds, hands the config object to F_3DTransformObjectAllocator. Finally dispatches the game state via GameStateBranchDispatch and returns 0. Called by CamMan_Init.

local_names.v3: constructed config object stored at this+0x18
local_names.v4: source directory path string to copy into the buffer

operations.description: If this+0x18 (this[6]) is zero, lazily allocate the config object on first call.
Store the constructed object pointer in this+0x18 (this[6]).
Append the "cams.cfg" filename string to the path buffer.
Invoke the vtable+4 method on the config object (base *(this+0x18)) with the "cams.cfg" path; the fallback-directory branch is taken only when it returns non-zero.
Select the source directory path: dword_5EC440, or byte_5EA438 when dword_5EC440 is zero.
Copy the source directory string byte-by-byte over the path buffer until the NUL terminator.
Append the "default.cfg" filename string to the path buffer.
Invoke the vtable+4 method on the config object with the "default.cfg" path; proceed to allocation only on non-zero result.
F_3DTransformObjectAllocator processes the loaded 3D transform data in the config object.
GameStateBranchDispatch(this) dispatches the game state after config loading.
Invoked by CamMan_Init (0040c920) during camera-manager initialization.
